papers.title: Impact of ESG Disclosure on Cost of Capital: Evidence from NIFTY 500 Firms
papers.keywords: ESG disclosure; cost of equity; emerging markets
papers.abstract: This paper investigates ESG disclosure, cost of equity and emerging markets in the Indian context. Using machine learning classifiers, the study analyses data from district-level data for 640 districts. Results indicate short-term gains that fade over time. The findings contribute to the literature on ESG disclosure and offer practical implications for managers and policy makers in emerging economies.
